name: game-projects
goal: Both dimensions play key-door branching mechanics with editable checkpoint graphs and capped AI preview

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Approved plan: both dimensions; executable authoring graph with AI guidance; opt-in 60-second paid preview; key/door/branch acceptance. Red: /tmp/harness-game-red.log (6 failures before runtime/scaffold implementation).

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Local CLI/scaffolds, deterministic engine, 2D/3D renderers, interactive checkpoint graph, mechanics contracts, optimistic saves implemented. Opus 5.5 authored frontend. Live AI remains pending: public vendor SDK exposes ephemeral credential in URL; host and browser fail closed before credential access or capture.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Eight browser scenarios, thirteen engine tests, four host integration tests and root integration/impact cases pass. Both generated dimensions pass standalone check. Live quality/latency blocked pending compliant transport and dedicated project credential.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
steps.evidence: Root check exercised; compatibility failures repaired and targeted tests rerun. Final package/browser checks recorded in /tmp/harness-game-*-final.log. Live provider acceptance remains pending.
